transcript:
SOURCE: Fathom (via HubSpot internal notes) — https://fathom.video/share/Vbd4yiVsjSzWdUqsYiVQnU9BfVz-9pcH

AI Meeting Summary ✨

Generated by Fathom // View Recording (52 mins - No highlights)

Meeting Purpose

To assess if SMB Team can support Kelly's rapidly growing law firm.

Key Takeaways

Rapid Growth: Kelly's firm grew from a solo practice to 5 lawyers and 2 staff in 4 months, creating operational strain.

Primary Challenges: The firm faces cash flow strain from slow client payments and lacks financial visibility for strategic planning.

Strategic Goal: Scale the unique fractional GC model from a projected $3M to $5M ARR in 18–24 months by closing large VC proposals.

Proposed Solution: A phased SMB Team engagement starting with Business Coaching and a Fractional CFO to build a scalable foundation.

Topics

Firm Status & Growth

Firm Launch: April 2, 2026, by Kelly Sullivan Angles (25-year business lawyer).

Initial Vision: Business transactions and fractional general counsel (GC).

Rapid Expansion: Grew to 7 employees (5 lawyers, 1 paralegal, 1 assistant) in 4 months after a litigation co-counsel joined as Senior Counsel.

Financials:

Revenue: Kelly's practice generates $40k–$60k/month.

Cash Flow: Strain from slow-paying clients (30–45 day cycles) requires Kelly to capitalize expenses.

Goal: Break-even by October 2026; profitability by EOY 2026.

Primary Challenges

Financial Modeling: Lacks financial visibility and modeling skills for strategic planning.

Business Development: Unsure how to improve the close rate on proposals for the unique fractional GC model.

Operational Strain: The litigation team is at capacity, preventing pursuit of new work.

Systems: Unsure what "systems" are missing beyond current tools (Clio, MS 365, Westlaw).

Strategic Vision & Goals

Revenue Target: $5M ARR in 18–24 months.

Growth Driver: Close one or more large fractional GC proposals for VC funds, which would require hiring a new associate ($95k–$130k base).

Team Growth: Expand to ~15 employees within the current 3-year lease.

Personal Motivation: Ensure employee satisfaction and career growth.

Proposed Solution: SMB Team Engagement

SMB Team Model: A phased approach to build a scalable foundation before adding marketing.

Recommended Start:

Business Coaching: For strategic guidance and a proven blueprint.

Fractional CFO: To provide financial clarity, modeling, and cost control.

Future Add-ons: Fractional COO, fractional recruiting, marketing.

Next Steps

Jacob: Send case studies for Business Coaching and Fractional CFO services to Kelly (kelly@ksagc.com).

Jacob: Send a calendar invite for a proposal presentation on Wednesday, July 29, at 11:30 AM Central.

Kelly: Review materials before the Wednesday meeting.

Action Items

Confirm Fractional CRO availability; update Kelly - WATCH (5 secs)
Draft phased proposal for Kelly: coaching + fCFO; prep 4 options - WATCH (5 secs)
Send Kelly invite for Wed 11:30 CT; then host call - WATCH (5 secs)
Email Kelly case studies + recap re: coaching + fCFO - WATCH (5 secs)
